name: sitting woodchopper on stability ball
description: Seated on a ball, you chop diagonally across your body. It trains the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
